answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. What survives to the harbor is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Each submission hangs on the echo of a task receipt, and the opal is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
